featured_reviews.name: Gaurav Malu
featured_reviews.review_text:
We were looking to buy wedding attire for my father under quite challenging circumstances. The wedding was just 2–3 days away, we were visiting from Jaysingpur (Kolhapur), my father wears an XL size, and we had only one single day to shop for him before he had to leave for another city due to urgent work.

We had purchased outfits from Kalki about 4–5 years ago and always loved how their designs matched our taste and style. When I checked online and saw that Kalki had introduced a men’s collection as well, we didn’t think twice and headed straight to the store. We reached around 12:15 pm, where Mr. Rizwan, the sales executive, warmly greeted us and patiently understood our requirements. He showed us a few outfits, one of which we immediately liked. My father tried it on, and some fitting alterations were required.

When we explained our tight timeline, the stylist Mr. Loken, who had been attentively observing and listening, immediately understood the urgency. With calm confidence, he simply said, “I’ll give it to you by 8 pm.” That one sentence brought immense relief to us.

We are genuinely grateful to Mr. Loken and Mr. Rizwan for their kindness, professionalism, and willingness to go the extra mile. Despite the time constraints, they ensured the outfit was perfectly altered and delivered on the very same day. Experiences like these truly set Kalki apart — not just for their designs, but for the people who stand behind them.

Thank you for making a stressful situation so smooth and memorable. 🙏

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: Gauravi Thakur Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Kalki Santacruz staff is seriously ruining the brand’s image with their poor service and unprofessional behavior.
I purchased a saree with a ready blouse in a hurry and, unfortunately, did not check the product thoroughly before payment. After payment and alterations, I noticed the blouse was damaged, with stitches coming out. Due to time constraints, I took it after being assured by the staff that it would be fixed properly if I brought it back.
I returned the blouse for fixing on 12/11/2025. Later, I called to check if it was ready and was informed that it was. However, when I went to collect it on 27/11/2025, the blouse was in an even worse condition—not only was the stitching poorly done, but the embroidery/work at the back was also coming apart.
When I raised this issue, the staff, including the store manager and tailor, behaved rudely but assured me again that it would be fixed.
On Sunday, 21st December, I contacted the store to check the status. They told me their system showed the blouse as “fixed,” which was clearly false, as they had already called me earlier to collect it when it was not ready. I requested them to reconfirm and get back to me.
Since then, there has been no response, despite multiple attempts to contact the store. The lack of accountability and communication is extremely frustrating.
This experience has been a complete waste of money, time, and trust. For a brand like Kalki, this level of service is unacceptable.
I strongly advise others to think twice before buying from this store

Images are of 27/11/2025 when they had called me to collect my ready blouse

featured_reviews.name: shilpa kasuba
featured_reviews.review_text:
My cousin reached out to ISA for my reception look, and as a plus-size bride, I was honestly very nervous about how the outfit would turn out. Since I was in the US and couldn’t come in for alterations, I was especially anxious about the fit.
The ISA team walked me through every step of the measurement and design process, making sure everything would be just right. When I finally received the outfit, I was beyond amazed. The stitching, the design, the fit, the embroidery — every single detail was absolutely perfect.
I received so many compliments, and the dress was truly the highlight of the evening! Thank you for bringing our vision to life so beautifully. My cousin and I couldn’t be happier with the outcome.
I highly recommend ISA to any bride — or anyone looking for the perfect outfit for a special occasion!

featured_reviews.name: Ashka Rao
featured_reviews.review_text:
I wanted something different for my wedding and didn’t want to look like a cookie-cutter bride, which is why I chose ISA by Dolly. I went to them with my color analysis to help me find the right shade for my skin tone, and they were incredibly patient and understanding throughout the process.

They customized my lehenga beautifully - it turned out so unique and truly felt like me. I shared my measurements online without ever visiting the store, and the fit was absolutely perfect, which honestly exceeded my expectations.

The only thing I’d recommend for future brides is to book well in advance before your big day to avoid any last-minute stress. I received my lehenga just a week before the wedding, but despite the timeline, everything was flawless in terms of sizing and finish.

Overall, I’m so happy with my experience and would definitely recommend ISA by Dolly to brides looking for something personalized and distinctive!

featured_reviews.name: Riya Godwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Discovered ISA by Dolly Wahal through Pernia’s Pop-Up Shop, and it’s honestly been such a beautiful journey since then ✨

I’ve been following their work on Instagram for a while and absolutely love their aesthetic. Since there’s no showroom in my city (Indore), I explored multiple of their outfits through Pernia’s and finally chose this stunning gold ensemble for my reception—and it couldn’t have been more perfect.

For such a big function, I was looking for something heavy, shimmery, and elegant (I naturally gravitate towards gold), and this outfit had everything I had in mind. The craftsmanship is beautiful, the detailing is so graceful, and the overall feel of wearing it was just amazing.

It was not just me—even my entire family loved the look!

Would highly recommend ISA by Dolly Wahal to all brides-to-be looking for something timeless, grand, and effortlessly elegant ✨

featured_reviews.name: Devanshi Grover
featured_reviews.review_text: I wore an outfit by Isa by Dolly for my sangeet night and absolutely loved it! The fit and attention to detail were just perfect. It made me feel so comfortable while dancing the night away. Truly a beautiful blend of elegance and style—highly recommend! ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Raashi Dhameja
featured_reviews.review_text:

After multiple colour samples, we finally reached a point where in the customised wedding lehnga looked stunning, not only because of a beautiful coral orange day light colour, but also for the amount of attention paid on the detailing of the embroidery done to make it shine out brighter.
Overall, it was an amazing experience and definitely  recommend the designer for a modern day bride who is looking for unique designs.

featured_reviews.name: Wafa Aga
featured_reviews.review_text:
can’t put into words how special my experience with Isa by Dolly Wahal has been. The moment I saw my engagement outfit, I knew it was the one — I didn’t want to look at anything else after that. It felt like something I had always dreamt of, long before this day even came.

A huge thank you to Simran, who is not only incredibly talented but also so warm and understanding — she made the entire journey feel effortless and personal.
I’ll always be grateful for this experience and for an outfit that turned such a special moment into a lifelong memory. Highly, highly recommend 🤍✨
